title: Generic Pair
description:
Implement a generic `Pair<A, B>` class that holds two values and supports `swap()` and `map()`.

**Example:**
```ts
const p = new Pair(1, 'hello');
p.first   // 1
p.second  // 'hello'
p.swap()  // Pair<string, number>('hello', 1)
p.map(x => x * 2)  // Pair<number, string>(2, 'hello')
```
ai_context: Common mistake: forgetting to declare type parameters on the class and methods separately. `map<C>` introduces a new type parameter C independent of A and B.
